seo.title: Documents
seo.seo_title: AI search across your own documents
seo.seo_description: Ask a question in plain language: the answer comes from your own documents, with its sources. Contracts, quotes, procedures: find, summarize, extract.

blocks.role: Promesse de la solution documents : retrouver la bonne clause, avec sources.

translation.headline: The right clause. The right version. Found.
translation.subheadline: Ask your question in plain language: the answer comes from your own documents, cites its sources and sends you back to the original passage. Like a colleague who has read everything, and who shows you where.

blocks.role: Problème : exemple construit d'un cabinet de services professionnels.

translation.title: Documents that hide.
translation.body:
A professional-services firm accumulates contracts, quotes, procedures and file notes, spread across several folders and several versions. Finding the clause of an old contract means digging through several folders and calling a colleague.

The example is constructed to illustrate the principle; it is not a customer's result.

items.title: Several versions.
items.text: Which one is right? The signed one, or the last one edited?

items.title: A memory held in heads.
items.text: When a person leaves, landmarks go with them.

items.title: Searches to repeat.
items.text: The same question, asked by three people, is searched for three times.

blocks.role: Ce que fait le système : constituer la base, répondre avec sources, résumer, extraire.

translation.title: Searching your documents, in plain language.
translation.intro: Functions of WorkStudio, the tool that puts answers drawn from your own documents within your reach, assembled for your case.

cards.title: A knowledge base.
cards.text: You drop in documents (PDF, Word, text, web pages) or connect a synced source. They are split up and indexed (filed so they can be found quickly); by default the computing is done on the instance's server.

cards.title: Answers with their sources.
cards.text: The agent (software that completes a task using the tools you authorize) searches the base first, answers, numbers its sources and makes them clickable. A safeguard can check the answer's faithfulness to your documents.

cards.title: Summaries and extracts.
cards.text: A starter template summarizes a contract (deadlines, amounts, clauses to have reviewed). It does not replace a lawyer. Scanned documents can be read too, more slowly.

cards.title: Structured fields.
cards.text: When a document follows a known form (quote, purchase order), the system pulls out fields filed in a table.

blocks.role: Ce que reçoit l'équipe : mosaïque de bénéfices (bento).

translation.title: A memory that stays when people leave.
translation.intro: A way to ask your own documents a question, in WorkStudio's internal Assistant or in a chat you publish.

cards.title: An answer and its sources.
cards.text: One click opens the document or shows the passage used.

cards.title: A company memory.
cards.text: Knowledge of the files stays in the base when someone leaves.

cards.title: Traces to review.
cards.text: Questions left unanswered reveal what your documents do not say.

cards.title: An Assistant close at hand.
cards.text: The Assistant is an internal chat where the team talks to the company's published agents.

blocks.role: Bénéfice attendu, sans chiffre ; lien diagnostic.

translation.title: Less searching, more answers.
translation.body:
The expected benefit: less time spent searching, less dependence on one person's memory. No time saved is announced; the effect is measured during a pilot, on your real questions.

Book a diagnosis to choose which documents to query first.

blocks.role: Ce qui reste sous contrôle, avec limites ; carte données avec lien Vos données.

cards.title: You choose the bases.
cards.text: The agent consults only the document bases you open to it. Access rights are set per base and per workspace, not document by document.

cards.title: Where your documents are indexed.
cards.text: By default, indexing is computed on the instance's server: with you, on your server; in hosted mode, in Nexora AI's infrastructure in Quebec. An external service is a written choice.

cards.title: No legal advice.
cards.text: The contract summary flags clauses to have reviewed. It replaces neither a lawyer nor a careful reading.

cards.title: The AI can be wrong.
cards.text: A model can misread a passage. The cited sources let you verify, and we check faithfulness to the documents during the pilot.

cards.title: Web search stays a choice.
cards.text: If it is turned on for an agent, its queries leave the instance: we do not turn it on for agents that handle confidential data.

cards.title: Your data stays yours.
cards.text: Never used to train a model, never sold. An external model comes in only when you explicitly activate it, in writing.

blocks.role: FAQ propre à la solution documents.

items.question: Which file types?
items.answer: PDFs, Word documents, text and web pages. Scanned documents are read with a reading model, more slowly.

items.question: Are my documents sent elsewhere?
items.answer: By default, no: indexing is computed on the instance's server. If you choose an external model to answer, the passages used are sent to it; we state this beforehand, in writing.

items.question: Does the agent say so when it finds nothing?
items.answer: That is the aim of the configuration, and we verify it during the pilot on your documents. A faithfulness safeguard reduces unsupported answers; it does not eliminate them.

items.question: Can we limit what each person sees?
items.answer: You limit what each agent consults, base by base. Document-by-document access rights are not announced today.

translation.title: Question your documents.
translation.text: We prepare a demonstration on fictional documents, then we talk about yours and where they must stay. A partner from here installs, runs and trains with you.
